'''Z-37''' was an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-series pilot droid]] owned by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Z-37 was destroyed when the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] boarded Kishpaugh's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and accused the Commander of treachery against the Republic. In the encounter, Kishpaugh inadvertently shot and destroyed Z-37 with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. He had gold plating.
